title: Miley Cyrus, Charli xcx, Snoop Dogg & More Set to Present at 2026 Golden Globes: Full List of Presenters
summary: Comedian Nikki Glaser will host for the second year in a row. The show airs live coast-to-coast on Sunday (Jan. 10).
contentText:
Music stars Miley Cyrus , Charli xcx , Snoop Dogg , Amanda Seyfried , Queen Latifah and Joe Keery are among the presenters for the 2026 Golden Globes. The show will air live coast-to-coast on Sunday, Jan. 11 (8:00-11:00 p.m. ET/5:00-8:00 p.m. PT) on CBS, streaming on Paramount+ in the U.S. Comedian Nikki Glaser will host the show for the second year in a row.

Cyrus is nominated for a Golden Globe for best original song for co-writing “Dream as One” from Avatar: Fire and Ash with Andrew Wyatt, Mark Ronson and Simon Franglen.

Keery, one of the stars of Stranger Things , has also had success as a recording artist as Djo. His 2024 song “End of Beginning” re-enters this week’s Billboard Hot 100 at No. 16 due to renewed interest spurred by the Stranger Things series finale.

The list of presenters also includes Kevin Hart , nominated for best performance in stand-up comedy on television for Kevin Hart: Acting My Age ; Jason Bateman , Sean Hayes and Will Arnett, who co-host SiriusXM’s Smartless , which is nominated for best podcast; Zoë Kravitz ( Blink Twice , The Batman ); actress Priyanka Chopra Jonas ( Citadel , Quantico ), the wife of Nick Jonas; married couple actors Kevin Bacon and Kyra Sedgwick ; and Connor Storrie and Hudson Williams, stars of the much-buzzed-about HBO Max hockey miniseries Heated Rivalry .

The Golden Globes, which likes to call itself “Hollywood’s Party of the Year,” is the world’s largest awards show to celebrate the best of film, television, and now podcasting. Glenn Weiss and Ricky Kirshner of White Cherry Entertainment (WCE) will return as executive producing showrunners for the 83rd annual Golden Globes.
